title: Widen decider Priority 4 expansion filter to accept 'ready-for-integration' (tracker status vocabulary drift fix, OPT-1)
problem: decider.md:248 Priority 4 trigger (and the duplicated filter in decider-curmudgeon-pq-mechanics.md lines 3 + 13) only matched status 'complete' || 'revised'. analyst vocabulary circa 2026-04-27 also produced 'ready-for-integration', which no consumer accepted — items at that status accumulated silently for 75+ days (EXP-626 from 2026-04-27; EXP-650/651/652/653 from 2026-07-05/06, unblocked by operator manual flip 2026-07-12). decider prints 'NO PENDING EXPANSIONS' when the filter matches nothing, so the blockage was invisible.

fix.shape: Pure filter widening — same string edit at all three duplicated sites. No Priority 4 refactor, no analyst prompt change, no workspace-sync involvement.
edits: monitor/prompts/reference/decider-curmudgeon-pq-mechanics.md:3 — load-condition doc sentence widened to match
monitor/prompts/reference/decider-curmudgeon-pq-mechanics.md:13 — Step 2a enumeration filter widened to match
